ops.text: drive relays from a Sprite lane to the coordinator's Mac (drive pr add, drive job set --repro, drive job report) routinely hit the 9-minute relay limit and need two or three --resume waits; j6132's drive pr add for yasyf/cc-skills#5647 sat unanswered past 27 minutes while the meta session wanted it landed at once. A relay that returned a queued id at once, and a verb to read its result later, would let the lane keep working instead of parking on a blocking Bash call.
